title: Sawed-Off
author: Machape21
selftext:
Made a game about *repairing guns while the rave next door shakes everything on your bench.*

It was made for the MegaGameJam 2026. Intense 4 days, didn't stop doing stuff, even sleeping 4 hours a day xD

About the reference, I was thinking about the game Restory, but with guns, with a Mike Klubnika style. Looking forward to make it a full game, so hope people like this demo!

Would love to have the time now, without the game jam, to make every gun more handcrafted. Because of the schedule, I wasn't able to add all the parts I would like to some guns.

But it was a really fun experience, since I didn't take part in a jam in years.

Hope I can make more games with the same Lore, I have some more stuff in my mind.  
[https://adriii.itch.io/sawed-off](https://adriii.itch.io/sawed-off)
